description: Full profile of one convention by slug: dates, venue and address, website, artist-alley and vendor registration windows/costs/URLs, every published price tier (artist spaces, dealer booths, badges; this edition and past ones) with its source, portfolio and table-share policy, hotel block, transit access, organizer verification, and up to 6 years of attendance/pricing history. Get slugs from artistally_search_conventions or an ArtistAlly event URL.

slug.description: Convention slug, e.g. "otafest" — the last segment of an ArtistAlly /events/ URL.

name: artistally_get_convention
title: Get convention details
